name: offers-dashboard-server
description: Backend API server for offers dashboard

scripts.sync-flows: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const src=p.join('..','..','core','lib','flows'),dst='flows';fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(src).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.yml')))fs.copyFileSync(p.join(src,f),p.join(dst,f));console.log('Synced flow ymls into ./flows');"
scripts.build:image: npm run sync-flows && docker build -t offers-dashboard .
